_read_this_first: This file is NOT deployed by the current Terraform (terraform/logic_app.tf). It was the raw Logic App workflow definition for an earlier design that used the Office 365 Outlook connector's 'Send approval email' action, deployed via the azapi provider. That design required a Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online mailbox and a manual one-time OAuth authorization click - unworkable for a lab environment without an M365 tenant.
_current_design: The Logic App is now pure native-azurerm HCL (see terraform/logic_app.tf): a Request trigger plus one HTTP action that forwards the finding to the Function App's /api/request-approval endpoint. The Function App (functions/function_app.py + functions/shared/notifications.py) builds the approval email itself and sends it via Azure Communication Services Email, authenticated with its own Managed Identity - no mailbox, no OAuth, no connection string.
_why_kept_in_the_repo: Files already written to this project's output folder can't be deleted from this environment, so this file remains as a documented artifact of the design's evolution rather than being silently replaced. Feel free to delete it yourself once you've copied this project to your own machine/GitHub repo - it has no functional role.
